name: Test: Killzone on two worlds
description: Fights the Killzone front-line war on two worlds at once: Vekta on the Corinth map and Helghan on a placeholder (the Corinth map mirrored, in ash and dust). For testing the several-worlds system (Killzone Extrasolar War, phases K1a and K1b).
